<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read the input matrix
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
id_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_columns]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missingness_data = []
kept_indicators = []

for indicator in indicator_columns:
    missing_count = df[indicator].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        "indicator": indicator,
        "missing_count": int(missing_count),
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": kept
    })
    if kept:
        kept_indicators.append(indicator)

# Create missingness report DataFrame
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)

# Write missingness report with RFC 4180 compliance
report_path = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)
with open(report_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    writer.writerow(["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"])
    for row in missingness_data:
        writer.writerow([row["indicator"], row["missing_count"], row["missing_rate"], row["kept"]])

# Create selected matrix with only kept indicators
selected_columns = id_columns + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_columns]

# Write selected matrix with RFC 4180 compliance
selected_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
with open(selected_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    selected_df.to_csv(f, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

print("Missingness report written to:", report_path)
print("Selected matrix written to:", selected_path)
print("\nMissingness Report:")
print(report_df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nKept indicators:", kept_indicators)
print("\nSelected matrix shape:", selected_df.shape)
</solution_file>
